articles.title: Dónal Lunny, ‘colossus of Irish music’, dies aged 79
articles.summary: Founding member of Planxty, Lunny went on to play for bands such as Moving Hearts, the Bothy Band and Coolfin The Irish traditional musician Dónal Lunny has died at the age of 79 from cancer. articles.title: Nini Rodgers obituary
articles.summary: My friend Nini Rodgers, who has died aged 86, was a historian of Ireland’s involvement with slavery, the transatlantic slave trade and the abolition movement. In 2007, at the end of a four-decade career as a history lecturer at Queen’s University Belfast, she published Ireland, Slavery and Anti-Slavery: 1612-1865. In it she meticulously unmasked the…

articles.title: ‘How do we welcome the stranger, with humanity or anger?’ The forgotten Germans who found refuge in Ireland
articles.summary: A new play revisits the story of Ireland’s 18th-century German refugees, whose experience of prejudice and exclusion resonates with today’s debates over immigration In the early 18th century, a few thousand Germans fled religious persecution and near starvation in their homeland and ended up in remote rural Irish villages.
